basic_info.full_name: Anti-UAV: A Large Multi-Modal Benchmark for UAV Tracking
basic_info.organization_notes: Official sources identify the Anti-UAV challenge/project and paper authors, but a single authoritative dataset-owning organization was not confirmed in this source audit.
basic_info.citation: N. Jiang, K. Wang, X. Peng, X. Yu, Q. Wang, J. Xing, G. Li, J. Zhao, G. Guo, S. Han, Z. Liu, and W. Zheng, Anti-UAV: A Large Multi-Modal Benchmark for UAV Tracking, arXiv:2101.08466, 2021.

Anti-UAV300.relationship: Main target for this dataset card; first Anti-UAV RGB-T benchmark release.
Anti-UAV300.scale: 318 RGB-T video pairs; more than 580k frames/annotations reported by official sources.

Anti-UAV410.relationship: Later Anti-UAV benchmark version in the same challenge/benchmark family, not the main card target.
Anti-UAV410.scale: 410 thermal infrared video sequences, with official train/validation/test splits reported as 240/70/100.

Anti-UAV600.relationship: Later Anti-UAV benchmark version in the same challenge/benchmark family, not the main card target.
Anti-UAV600.scale: 600 thermal infrared video sequences and over 650,000 frames.

modality_evidence.evidence: The official repository describes Anti-UAV300 as containing RGB-T video pairs and lists Google Drive/Baidu dataset release links.
The paper describes Anti-UAV as a large multi-modal benchmark using RGB and thermal infrared videos for UAV tracking.

data_scale.total_size: Anti-UAV-RGBT.zip downloaded and validated: 6,037,566,331 bytes compressed; 6,720,200,225 bytes extracted estimate/file-inspection size.
data_scale.sequence_count: 318 RGB-T video pairs; all 318 passed lightweight pairing scan.
data_scale.video_count: 636 MP4 videos in archive: 318 visible.mp4 and 318 infrared.mp4.
data_scale.frame_count: Metadata-derived local archive count: 296901 RGB frames and 296901 IR frames (593802 modality frames total); official sources report more than 580k frames/annotations.
data_scale.annotation_count: Metadata-derived local archive count: 296901 visible annotation records and 296901 infrared annotation records; sampled JSON parsing passed.
data_scale.validation_count: 67 RGB-T video pairs, derived from paper wording that the rest after 160 train and 91 test are validation.

multimodal_association.same_sequence: YES; validated by archive structure across 318 sequences
multimodal_association.frame_level_correspondence: YES; sequence_id + frame_index validated as stable pairing key
multimodal_association.reason: Real files prove stable sequence-level and frame-index pairing across all 318 sequences. This is strong frame-level cross-modal association, not hardware-clock synchronization.

Anti-UAV410 is a later thermal infrared UAV tracking benchmark with 410 thermal infrared sequences and 240/70/100 train/validation/test split.
Anti-UAV600 is described as a thermal infrared UAV tracking benchmark with 600 sequences and over 650,000 frames.

notes: Anti-UAV300 has progressed from source-only status to real-data technical and RGB-IR cross-modal validation.
Frame pairing is confirmed through sequence_id + frame_index; hard synchronization is not confirmed.
The dataset is CROSS_MODAL_READY for internal knowledge-management validation but remains PARTIALLY_VERIFIED due to license risk and unresolved hard synchronization/sensor metadata limits.
Raw data must not be redistributed in public deliverables without explicit dataset-level permission.
blocking_reason: Official small paired RGB-T sample is not confirmed. The smallest confirmed real package is 6.04GB.
next_action: Use Anti-UAV300 as a CROSS_MODAL_READY frame-paired RGB-IR dataset for internal validation; do not claim hard synchronization or redistribute raw data without license confirmation.
limitations: No hard synchronization evidence: sensor-level trigger or unified hardware timestamp was not confirmed.
Only MP4/container timestamps are available; they are not treated as sensor timestamps.
Frame pairing is confirmed, but sensor-level synchronization is not.
RGB / IR target presence agreement is high but not perfect: infrared_only=61 was observed in the selected validation sample.
Dataset license remains RISK because explicit dataset-level license terms were not confirmed.
Five sequences were deeply inspected; all 318 sequences were checked through lightweight metadata and structural pairing validation.
Raw Anti-UAV300 data should not be redistributed in public delivery artifacts unless rights are explicitly confirmed.
